target: Per-request instance identity for shared HTTP MCP servers: replace env-passed DOPE_MEMORY_INSTANCE_ID/DOPEMUX_WORKSPACE_ID with per-request scoping, publish an instances registry, and unblock safe multi-instance routing per the 2026-07-10 probe contract.
invariants: MEMSPINE-IDENTITY-005 fail-closed law preserved: identity-less writes are rejected.
.mcp.json is an H1 contract surface; `dopemux mcp generate` remains its canonical writer.

commit.message: feat(mcp): per-request instance identity + instances registry for shared HTTP servers

pr.title: feat(mcp): per-request instance identity for dope-memory/conport
pr.body:
Env-block identity cannot scope shared HTTP servers per request and blocks safe multi-instance/ChatGPT routing (07-10 probe: instances.json missing, static base_url staleness, dual TO stacks). Adds per-request workspace/instance params with env fallback + deprecation warning, an instances registry with live-ownership resolution, and regenerated client configs.

Anchor: claudedocs/mcp-fleet-reconciliation-2026-07-18.md (P7/HRD).

steps.task: Add explicit per-request workspace/instance parameters to dope-memory and conport tool contracts (write paths mandatory, read paths accepted), keeping env fallback with a deprecation warning.
validation: Test drives two workspaces through one server instance and proves correct scoping per request.
Identity-less write is still rejected (fail-closed regression test passes).

steps.task: Generate instances.json (registry of live instances with ownership fingerprints) and implement resolver checks per CHATGPT_TARGET_RESOLUTION_CONTRACT.md (live TCP/fingerprint/ownership).
validation: Resolver refuses a stale or foreign target in a test; instances.json is produced by a dopemux command, not hand-written.

steps.task: Regenerate client configs via `dopemux mcp generate` so shared HTTP servers no longer carry per-workspace identity env blocks.
validation: Generated .mcp.json carries no DOPE_MEMORY_INSTANCE_ID/DOPEMUX_WORKSPACE_ID env for shared HTTP servers; catalog drift gate passes.
